title: Malty Chicken Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, this dish combines the flavors of malty and mexican cuisine with juicy chicken. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with cumin, chili powder, and salt and pepper.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of chicken onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of sour cream and shredded cheese if using.
Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
